articles.title: Volunteers Turn Out for the Fall Cleanup Across Foundry Row
articles.deck: The money will be spent over the next year, with the first work starting in June.
body: The group has raised $18,500 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food. The Foundry Row Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library.

articles.title: Zoning Board Hears Plan for After-school Reading Program Near Eastgate
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Maple Road disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Public works estimates the work will take about 32 weeks once it starts in January.

Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.
Residents of Eastgate said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.

articles.title: Scout Troop 14 Plans Winter Coat Drive for Fall
articles.deck: Organizers expect about 19 people and say winter coat drive is the main draw.
body: Anyone interested can attend the next planning meeting at the Millrace library on Saturday at 7 p.m.

Several residents on Elm Terrace said they had been waiting since 1976 for something like this. The effort began in April when a handful of neighbors met at the Millrace library to talk about winter coat drive.

articles.title: Letters: Juniper Drive Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I have lived on Juniper Drive for 9 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the November meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Vincent Wallace, Marsh Landing

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Cedar Hollow Garden Club
body: To the editor: I have lived on Calder Avenue for 31 years, and I want to say what a difference the Cedar Hollow Garden Club has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the October meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the park bench program in the budget. Many of us on Calder Avenue use it every week.
To the editor: I have lived on Calder Avenue for 31 years, and I want to say what a difference the Cedar Hollow Garden Club has made.
Esther Galloway, Foundry Row

articles.title: Letter: Support the Footpath Repair
body: To the editor: I have lived on Coal Drive for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program has made.
Please keep the footpath repair in the budget. Many of us on Coal Drive use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the November meeting.
Rosalind Nowicki, Cedar Hollow
